items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: 'We got to work together'. I said, 'you don't drink no more?' So I went down to hear him one night and here he was, he drank about two gallons of beer.

ctx.x: Not after he died, Helen, you mean just last year?
Just last year. They had it there for a long time. Jimmy died several years ago.
